BiblicalUsage: In the Bible, tsᵉrîyach means a citadel. In Judges 9:46, all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that, and it appears again in 1 Samuel 13:6.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that God put tsᵉrîyach exactly where it is, and I trust His placing of it.
